observed_run_metrics.result: B0 semantic rejection after one JSON-format rejection and one contract repair

measurement_interpretation.literal_prompt_chars: Measured locally from messages sent to Claude Code. This is distinct from CLI-reported input_tokens, which include large cache-hit values and must not be interpreted as a direct character-to-token conversion.

root_causes.cause: Maximum reasoning effort is requested for every external stage. It may consume extensive private model reasoning even when the accepted JSON is short.
root_causes.control: Do not lower effort silently; reduce repeated context and externally serialized prose instead.

root_causes.cause: S1 had no field-length budget, so its accepted scene-intent strings reached hundreds of characters and were repeated into B0/B1.
root_causes.control: E0/S1/B0 fields are now bounded to 180 characters and B1 to 240 characters, in prompt, transport schema when available, and local fail-closed decoding.

root_causes.cause: B0/B1 received broad dataclass serializations and rich capsule provenance not required for their stage decision.
root_causes.control: Use deterministic stage-specific Phase-A projections, K1 blocking payloads, K1 lineage-only B1 payloads, and K2 execution payloads. Full source provenance remains offline.

root_causes.cause: B1's full JSON Schema was longer than Windows can safely pass as one CLI argument.
root_causes.control: Use native argv schema only below 12000 characters; larger contracts carry a compact contract shape in stdin and remain locally strict-decoded.

root_causes.cause: The adapter classified a human error string containing 'permission' before reading the CLI JSON envelope. The minimal transport probe instead reported api_error_status 402, an empty permission_denials array, zero model usage, and immediate failure before inference.
root_causes.control: Classify envelope API status before human text: 402 is billing_or_credit_required and 403 is authorization_denied. Retain system-prompt replacement, empty tools, safe mode, disabled skills, and no session persistence; do not add broader permission bypasses.

root_causes.cause: Early checkpoint variants stored hashes but not enough typed state to resume B1 safely.
root_causes.control: New E0/S1 checkpoints store typed Phase A; new B0/K2 checkpoints store typed BlockingCommit and deterministic K2 fingerprint. Historic runs remain evidence only and are not reconstructed from hashes.

next_real_run_preconditions: Restore the Claude Code DeepSeek route's billing or credit availability; HTTP 402 cannot be solved in the project code or bypassed by local permissions.
Run all CPL-2 and DDO regression tests after the budget/transport changes.
Record prompt_chars, schema_chars, and schema_transport on every provider call.
Start a fresh Shadow run rather than treating historic 005-007 artifacts as valid completion evidence.
If B1 fails after a new recoverable B0/K2 checkpoint, resume B1 only.
Keep the claim ceiling TEXT_VALIDATED and do not submit media or switch production.
